title: Port A Boat Rentals
specs: Boats are premium Barletta tritoon pontoons with 200+ HP engines
GPS geofencing and real-time monitoring enforce safety and location limits
Guest operator must be at least 25 years old
Present valid government-issued photo ID (driver's license, passport, or accepted foreign ID)
If born on or after Sept 1, 1993, must present valid Texas Boater Education Certificate or accepted equivalent
No DUI/DWI or similar convictions within 3 years prior to rental
Must complete all required documents and safety briefing at dock
Must be familiar and comfortable operating similar motorized vessels
Boat capacity per manufacturer placard: 24ft boat up to 10 guests, 22ft boat up to 8 guests
includes: USCG-approved life jackets for all guests
Safety equipment and first aid kit
gap: Exact prices by season not stated on extracted pages
blurb: Guests rent Barletta tritoon pontoon boats to cruise, anchor, swim, paddleboard, and dockside dine on Corpus Christi Bay. Rentals are self-operated by qualified guest operators who must meet age, ID, and boating education requirements. Boats are equipped with GPS geofencing and safety equipment; operation is restricted to daylight hours and bay waters only.
extraNote: Payment due in full at booking · Fuel included for standard bay cruising; excessive use may incur extra charges · Mandatory damage coverage fee charged per rental, non-refundable after departure · Credit card authorization hold ($500–$1,000) placed before departure, released after inspection · Cancellation 7+ days before rental: full refund; 2-7 days: 50% refund; less than 48 hours or no-shows: no refund · Company may cancel for weather with full refund or free reschedule · Designated dock area within Island Moorings Yacht Club marina, Port Aransas, TX · Year-round on a seasonal schedule based on daylight conditions
